name: Roxy 11 Apt, 3 BDR
headline: Elegant & Modern 3 BDR Apt. @ Heliopolis
summary: This elegant 3 bedroom apartment is perfect for Families & business travelers.

description.Space:
This elegant 3 bedroom apartment is perfect for Families & business travelers.  
The 3 bedroom apartment includes a spacious reception area with a combined living that includes a bright outdoor balcony.  There is a fully equipped kitchen, cooking utensils and a Nespresso coffee machine. The living room is furnished with a sofa set along with a 55 inch smart TV with AirPlay built-in for further personal entertainment. There is full bathrooms which is equipped with a bath tub & one guest bath. 
The first bedroom includes a king size bed & along with a spacious wardrobe.
The second bedroom includes one queen size bed, and the third bedroom includes one single bed.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment.
description.Interaction: Guests can text and call us anytime they need assistance. We'll be happy to address any issues right away.
description.Neighborhood:
The neighborhood is full of life with plenty of street food options (the apartment is quite and peaceful though) 

- Banks and other services are also within walking distance. 
- Cairo Complex is within 20min walking distance and is packed with hangouts. 
- Giza Pyramids is a 50 min drive
- Downtown Cairo is a 30 min drive 
- New Cairo is a 15 min drive
- Cairo International Airport is a 15 min drive.
description.Transit:
We provide concierge services that include airport transfers and private day tours. 

All places are reachable by car, Uber app and Careem app but if you wish to take a walk it's takes no more than 5 minutes to reach any of the services around.
description.Notes:

Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 200 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).

• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

This is a great place to stay while in Cairo. The apartment has everything you need and the hosts respond right away to any issues. The WiFi is good which is a must these days. It’s on a quiet side street in a busy area. The only issue we had was check in as the lockbox is on the apartment but you need a fob to use the elevator to get there in the first place. They could also use some hooks in the bathrooms. Thank you for a pleasant stay. Highly recommend!

I stayed here for almost a week in July. This apartment is perfect, so new and beautiful, perfectly clean and layout is lovely. Even decorated very tastefully. Kitchen is perfectly equipped whether you just want to make an espresso or a full meal. They give you toiletries and clean towels. The Xuru Team is very responsive and helpful with any issues and checks in often to make sure all is ok. We had a little trouble checking in as the instructions weren’t clear and that was the only time the Xuru Team was late in their response time which caused us to wait and be frustrated. However, they made it right and assured me they would clear up check in instructions for future clients and perhaps include photos to help check in. Other than that, everything went perfectly smooth and we were extremely comfortable and happy! Neighborhood has everything close by, Ubers didn’t have any issues finding it as well. Don’t hesitate to book this place! Thank you Xuru!

Despite the unit's modern look with new kitchen equipment and furniture, my stay was disappointing. Several issues made it uncomfortable:
- Lack of check-in information made accessing the unit confusing.
- To make matters worse, the floor was still wet from cleaning, forcing me to wait before entering. The cleaning products left a strong, unpleasant odor that lingered in the unit. Due to the smell, I ended up leaving and waited for the air to clear before returning.
- Yellow stains on linen were unhygienic and clearly hadn't been changed.
- A strong gas smell was noticeable.
- Unstable water pressure was frustrating especially during the shower.
- Hygiene standards were subpar.
- Basic amenities like tea, spices, salt, and pepper were missing.
- Towels were worn out and improperly stored.
- Slow and unstable internet added to the frustration.
- Lack of hooks in bathrooms and bedrooms made it hard to organize belongings.
Overall, the unit's appearance didn't match the quality of stay.

Highly recommended!!!

I had an absolutely amazing stay at this apartment! The place was immaculate, beautifully maintained, and very comfy. The apartment is located in a nice location near everything! Also, It was spacious, and had everything we needed to feel right at home. 

The host was very responsive, polite and very helpful. Would definitely love to come back again. Thank you for the wonderful hospitality!

My family and I stayed here for 5 weeks. We booked this apartment due to location and it did not disappoint, walkable distance to a lot of the areas we were after. The actual apartment itself was clean and modern, and when we requested someone to come by to clean and change the linen/towels/floors due to a longer stay, we were able to be assisted. We did wish there was at least some sort of handheld/mini vacuum so we could clean as needed in between. We had a couple of misunderstandings with communicating with the company itself about some issues we had, however the people that were sent to physically attend to any of the issues, Rimon and team, were outstanding. Polite, respectful, willing to assist and we honestly couldn’t fault him. For future, would be handy to have two key fobs (as we were 4 people staying there, makes moving around separately hard) and more reliable internet. Overall, with the minor tweaks, would absolutely book this place again.

Positive:
Really great location, with lots of shops and restaurants in the local area. Finding the location was simple with the directions and video link provided. The apartment was clean and the facilities were very good. The bed was comfortable, and the main bathroom has a great shower. The outside noise was fairly quiet for Cairo. Communication with Xuru Stays was excellent, and they responded very quickly. The Wifi worked well.

Negative:
The lift needs the tag that is with the keys to work, so when arriving, you can ask the doorman to activate it to get upstairs for the first time, or walk up the stairs if they aren't about. When leaving, you need to prop the lift door open with a bag, then have just enough time to activate the lift, run back to the door, place the keys in the box, close it and spin the dials, then get back to the lift. It may take a couple of attempts. It would be nice to have some towel hooks or rail in the bathroom to put wet towels, but there is a drying rack that can be used.

Positive:
We did not stay.  Apartment looked nice but we were in there only for 10 minutes and had to leave and we could not get out.  The door was an electronic lock.  Cleaners were there when we arrived but had no instruction about door.  We were locked in on the 7th floor and no other way out.  3 of us tried and even googled the type of lock.  Google said probably the battery is going.  We called the property manager and she sent over the 2 cleaners.  They played with it for 15 min and it did not work.  As we called the manager again  it suddenly worked.  she offered us a 2 bedroom instead of the 3 we had. At first we were going to do that but then found out ir was not in same building but some 10 min away.  The road is so congested it takes 20 min to get in and out of the road so we declined.  As we had to be at the Cairo Marathon leaving at 5 am next morning we opted to leave.  They refuse a refund.  Safety wise we could not take a chance that we were locked in in case of fire or medical emergency let alone get out at 5am.  We left.  So far no refund honoredl.

Positive:
Worst experience ever. Structural collapse, dangerous, and completely abandoned by the host."

We had a catastrophic experience at this property. We did a self check-in, and when we returned to the apartment late at night, we were shocked to find that the entire upper kitchen partition/wall had completely collapsed onto the marble counter, shattering glass and breaking the heavy marble slab everywhere. This is a severe, life-threatening safety hazard.

To make matters worse, the host was completely unresponsive and non-cooperative. We tried calling and messaging multiple times during this emergency, but we were totally ignored. No one replied or came to assist us, forcing us to evacuate and look for another hotel late at night.

Additionally, the building itself was extremely dirty and poorly maintained. The elevator mechanism is a nightmare; it does not operate unless you scan the physical key inside it. The host only provided a single set of keys. This means no one can leave or enter the apartment independently; if you are with someone else, you are forced to stick together at all times because whoever doesn't have the key cannot even use the elevator to get to the apartment. Absolutely unacceptable management and a highly dangerous property.
